outcome: Give Tech teams a working Tech Support Ticket Triage & Deflection Copilot capability on their own data — it deflects a large share of tickets and cuts resolution time.
overview: Most of a technical support queue is issues the documentation already answers, and every one a human touches adds to cost-to-serve while first-response targets slip. This copilot classifies and routes each incoming ticket, and answers the repetitive ones directly from the knowledge base, citing the article behind every response so the customer and the agent can check it. Answers stay grounded in cleared content and escalate to a person whenever confidence is low, because a confidently wrong deflection costs more than the ticket did. A four-week build on real ticket history and the live knowledge base shows the deflectable share and what the knowledge base still lacks.
